location.en: Exam room at Maple Bay Family Clinic

goal.en: Describe your symptoms clearly and ask about your medicine.
goal.zh: 清楚描述症狀，並詢問用藥的注意事項。

background: small clean doctor's exam room, padded exam table with a white paper cover, a rolling stool, a small sink and wooden cabinets, window with half-open blinds, calm soft daylight

intro.en: You're the first walk-in of the day. A nurse leads you into a small exam room.
intro.zh: 你是今天第一位現場候診的病人。護理師帶你走進一間小診間。

lines.en: So, what brings you in today?
lines.zh: 那麼，今天是哪裡不舒服呢？

choices.en: I've had a sore throat for three days, and it's getting worse.
choices.zh: 我喉嚨痛三天了，而且越來越嚴重。
choices.tip: I've had... for three days. 用現在完成式說明症狀持續多久，醫生最需要這個資訊。

choices.en: I think I have too much fire inside. My throat is very hot.
choices.zh: 我覺得我火氣太大了。喉嚨很燥熱。

lines.en: Fire inside? Do you mean a fever? Or maybe heartburn?
lines.zh: 身體裡有火？你是說發燒嗎？還是胃食道逆流？

story.en: Dr. Patel checks your stomach for heartburn first. Ten minutes later, your throat finally gets its turn.
story.zh: 帕特爾醫師先檢查你的胃是不是胃酸逆流。十分鐘後，終於輪到你的喉嚨。

fail.why: 「上火」是中醫的概念，英語國家的醫生聽不懂。直接描述症狀和時間：I've had a sore throat for three days.

choices.en: I have sore throat since three days. Now it's more and more bad.
choices.zh: 我喉嚨痛從三天。現在越來越糟。

lines.en: Since three days... ago? Sorry, how long has this been going on?
lines.zh: 從三天……之前？抱歉，這情況持續多久了？

story.en: Dr. Patel writes "three weeks?" in your chart. You spend the next five minutes trying to fix it.
story.zh: 帕特爾醫師在病歷上寫了「三週？」。你花了五分鐘才把它更正過來。

fail.why: 症狀從過去持續到現在，要用現在完成式：I've had a sore throat for three days. for 接一段時間，since 接時間點；「越來越糟」是 getting worse。

lines.en: I see. Any other symptoms? A cough, a fever, anything like that?
lines.zh: 了解。還有其他症狀嗎？咳嗽、發燒之類的？

choices.en: A little cough, and it hurts when I swallow. No fever, though.
choices.zh: 有一點咳嗽，吞東西的時候會痛。不過沒有發燒。
choices.tip: It hurts when I... 說出什麼動作會痛，再補一句沒有哪些症狀，醫生判斷更快。

choices.en: I don't know. You're the doctor. Shouldn't you find out?
choices.zh: 我不知道。你才是醫生。不是應該你去查出來嗎？

lines.en: I will. But it helps a lot when patients tell me how they feel.
lines.zh: 我會的。不過病人告訴我感覺如何，對我幫助很大。

story.en: Dr. Patel goes through a long list of yes-or-no questions. The visit takes twice as long, and the waiting room fills up.
story.zh: 帕特爾醫師只好一題一題問是非題。看診時間多了一倍，候診室也坐滿了人。

fail.why: 醫生問症狀是要你描述感受，不是要你自己診斷。把感覺說出來就好：It hurts when I swallow.

choices.en: A little cough, and my nose is running water. No fever, I think.
choices.zh: 有一點咳嗽，還有流鼻水。應該沒發燒。

lines.en: Running water? Like a faucet? Oh, a runny nose. Okay.
lines.zh: 流水？像水龍頭那樣？喔，是流鼻水。好。

story.en: Dr. Patel focuses on your nose and never asks about swallowing. You leave with nose spray for a throat problem.
story.zh: 帕特爾醫師把重點放在鼻子，完全沒問到吞嚥的事。你帶著鼻噴劑回家，喉嚨卻還在痛。

fail.why: 「流鼻水」是 a runny nose 或 My nose is running.，不用加 water。也別忘了說最主要的症狀：It hurts when I swallow.

lines.en: Let me take a look. Open wide and say "ah."
lines.zh: 我看一下。嘴巴張大，說「啊」。

lines.en: Dr. Patel checks your throat with a small light.
lines.zh: 帕特爾醫師用小手電筒檢查你的喉嚨。

lines.en: It's a mild throat infection. I'll give you some medicine for five days. Any questions?
lines.zh: 是輕微的喉嚨發炎。我開五天的藥給你。有什麼問題嗎？

choices.en: Yes. Are there any side effects I should know about?
choices.zh: 有。有什麼副作用是我需要知道的嗎？
choices.tip: Are there any side effects? 拿新藥時一定要問，醫生會告訴你要注意什麼。

choices.en: Can I just get a shot instead? It works faster in Taiwan.
choices.zh: 可以直接打一針嗎？在台灣打針好得比較快。

lines.en: A shot? We don't usually give shots for a sore throat. The pills will do the job.
lines.zh: 打針？喉嚨痛我們通常不打針。吃藥就夠了。

story.en: You spend the rest of the visit trying to get a shot. You leave without asking a single question about your medicine.
story.zh: 你把剩下的看診時間都花在爭取打針。離開時，關於藥的事你一個問題都沒問。

fail.why: 在台灣有些人覺得打針好得快，但在楓灣，喉嚨痛這種小病醫生很少打針。把握機會問用藥：Are there any side effects?

choices.en: Yes. Did this medicine have any side effects?

lines.en: Did it? Have you taken this before? Did you have a bad reaction?
lines.zh: 有過？你以前吃過這個藥嗎？當時有不良反應嗎？

story.en: Dr. Patel spends ten minutes asking about a reaction you never had. Now your chart says "possible allergy."
story.zh: 帕特爾醫師花了十分鐘詢問一個根本沒發生過的反應。現在你的病歷上寫著「疑似過敏」。

fail.why: 問「會不會有副作用」用現在式：Are there any side effects? 或 Does it have any side effects? 用過去式 Did，醫生會以為你以前吃過而且出過狀況。

lines.en: Just a little drowsiness. Take one pill three times a day, after meals.
lines.zh: 只會有一點想睡。一天三次，每次一顆，飯後吃。

lines.en: Get plenty of rest. You should feel better in about five days.
lines.zh: 多休息。大概五天左右就會好轉。

choices.en: Okay. Should I come back if I don't feel better by then?
choices.zh: 好。如果到時候還沒好，我要再回來嗎？
choices.tip: Should I come back if...? 先問好沒好轉時該怎麼辦，回家就不用擔心。

choices.en: Five days? Sorry, I can't stay home. I have a test next week.
choices.zh: 五天？抱歉，我不能待在家。我下禮拜要考試。

lines.en: Oh, you don't need to stay home. I said you'll feel better in five days.
lines.zh: 喔，你不用待在家啦。我是說你大約五天會好轉。

story.en: Dr. Patel explains it again, slowly. You nod, embarrassed, and forget to ask what to do if it doesn't get better.
story.zh: 帕特爾醫師放慢速度再解釋一次。你尷尬地點頭，結果忘了問如果沒好轉該怎麼辦。

fail.why: 醫生說的是大約五天會好轉，不是要你在家休息五天。聽完先確認，再問後續：Should I come back if I don't feel better?

choices.en: After five days, if still not good, I come back see you?
choices.zh: 五天後如果還是不好，我再回來看你？

lines.en: Come back and see me? Like... for coffee? Oh, you mean a follow-up visit.
lines.zh: 回來看我？像是……喝咖啡嗎？喔，你是說回診。

story.en: Dr. Patel laughs, but the waiting room is full, so he hurries on to the next patient. You still aren't sure when to come back.
story.zh: 帕特爾醫師笑了出來，但候診室已經坐滿，他只好趕著看下一位。你還是不確定什麼時候該回診。

fail.why: 照中文語序直譯，英文聽起來斷斷續續，see you 還像是要約對方見面。問回診要說 Should I come back if I don't feel better by then?

lines.en: Yes. And if you get a fever, come back right away. Feel better!
lines.zh: 對。如果開始發燒，就馬上回來。早日康復！

lines.en: You pick up your medicine at the pharmacy next door.
lines.zh: 你到隔壁的藥局領了藥。

story.en: You take your pills, drink lots of water and go to bed early. By the weekend, you're singing in the shower again.
story.zh: 你按時吃藥、多喝水、早點睡。到了週末，你又能在洗澡時哼歌了。

notes.explain: 症狀從過去持續到現在，用現在完成式 have had。for 接一段時間（for three days），since 接時間點（since Monday）。

example.en: I've had a headache since Monday.
example.zh: 我從星期一就開始頭痛。

notes.explain: 說出什麼動作會引起疼痛，醫生比較好判斷問題在哪裡。

example.en: It hurts when I bend my knee.

notes.explain: 拿新藥時一定要問的一句。也可以接著問 Should I take it with food?（要飯後吃嗎？）

example.en: Are there any side effects I should know about?
example.zh: 有什麼副作用是我該知道的嗎？

notes.explain: 常見症狀：sore throat 喉嚨痛、cough 咳嗽、fever 發燒、runny nose 流鼻水、headache 頭痛。

example.en: My symptoms started on Sunday night.
example.zh: 我的症狀是星期天晚上開始的。

notes.explain: 在台灣看感冒常拿一大包藥，有時還會打針。楓灣的醫生通常只開必要的藥，輕微感冒甚至只叫你多休息、多喝水。

example.en: Just rest and drink plenty of fluids.
example.zh: 多休息，多補充水分就好。
